items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 33:1
items.html: The world of Beriah receives only the discernment of the illumination of the feet of the Partzufim of Atzilut, for the Atik of Beriah receives from the discernment of the NHY of the Atik of Atzilut, the AA of Beriah receives from the NHY of the AA of Atzilut, and so on in this manner, as the Rav wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 42, Chapter 13. However, when the NHY of Atik illuminate in Beriah, they come with their garments, which are the HGT of AA, because the NHY of Atik are clothed in the HGT of AA in Atzilut. Therefore, in the world of Beriah, where all the NHY of AA illuminate, and likewise all the NHY of Atik, the HGT of AA become a garment for Atik, just as they were in Atzilut, as above. And all the NHY of AA are clothed in the AVI and ZON of Beriah. However, in the world of Yetzirah, where only the middle thirds with the lower thirds of the NHY of Atik illuminate, and likewise of the NHY of AA, while the upper thirds of the NHY are lacking there — the two lower thirds of the NHY of Atik take with them the upper thirds of the NHY of AA that clothe them in Atzilut, because the middle thirds of the NHY of Atik are clothed from the Chazeh [chest] downward of AA, that is, also in the upper thirds of the NHY. Therefore it is discerned that these upper thirds of the NHY of AA do not belong to AA, but only to the discernment of a garment for Atik; and therefore they become a revealed head, which is a garment for the discernment of the RADLA [the concealed head] of Yetzirah. And only the two lower discernments of the NHY of AA, which are the middle thirds and the lower thirds of the NHY of AA, are what clothe in AVI. (Item 228).
